# SKOS

## Scope

Representation of knowledge organization systems (thesauri, taxonomies, classification schemes, subject heading lists) as RDF data.

## Requirements

Key constructs (paraphrased): `skos:Concept`, `skos:ConceptScheme`, labels (`prefLabel`, `altLabel`, `hiddenLabel`), documentation (`definition`, `scopeNote`), semantic relations (`broader`, `narrower`, `related`), and mapping relations across schemes (`exactMatch`, `closeMatch`, `broadMatch`, `narrowMatch`, `relatedMatch`). Integrity conditions include at most one `prefLabel` per language per concept.

## Applicability

Business glossaries, taxonomies, code-list semantics ([[Reference Data]]), mapping between vocabularies.
